title: publish-release.sh reads REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS and PROPAGATION_CUSHION_SECONDS into $(( )) unvalidated, the mechanism LCLI-626 fixed in readme-readback.sh
description: Found by the LCLI-626 delta reviewer (2026-09-28): the same mechanism in a second host. scripts/publish-release.sh sets REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS="${REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS:-1800}" and uses it in deadline=$(( started + REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS )) inside wait_for_all_visible, under set -uo pipefail (no -e) and macOS /bin/bash 3.2. PROPAGATION_CUSHION_SECONDS is read the same way and is unexamined. The reviewer's isolated 3-line probe under /bin/bash 3.2 showed 30m giving "value too great for base" with execution continuing to the next line. NOT measured on the real script: its behaviour on a malformed value (a wrong wait, an early exit, or a silent skip of the visibility gate) is unknown, and measuring it is the first step. LCLI-626 fixed readme-readback.sh by refusing any value outside ^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})$ before anything is read, with a fixed verdict line and the value shown only printf %q escaped; promote-latest.mjs exports that grammar as REGISTRY_WINDOW.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The real script's behaviour on a malformed REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS and PROPAGATION_CUSHION_SECONDS is measured under /bin/bash 3.2 and recorded here before any fix
publish-release.sh refuses a malformed value of either variable before any registry read or publish, with a non-zero exit; a test drives it under /bin/bash 3.2 and asserts nothing was published
The accepted grammar matches readme-readback.sh and promote-latest.mjs REGISTRY_WINDOW (one grammar, pinned by a test)
bun test, bun run lint:shell and bun run lore check exit 0; a reviewer pass covers the scripts change

plan: AC1: drive the real scripts/publish-release.sh under the macOS system shell (GNU shell 3.2.57) through the test/publish-release-script.test.ts harness (stub gh/npm/npx/security on PATH, NPM_TOKEN and NODE_AUTH_TOKEN unset, npm_config_registry pointed at a dead port) with REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS and PROPAGATION_CUSHION_SECONDS each set to 30m, abc, 08, 5+newline and empty; record exit code, wait behaviour, stub-log reads/publishes and stderr in a note BEFORE any fix

AC2: validate both variables right after argument parsing, before any registry read or publish, against the promote-latest.mjs REGISTRY_WINDOW grammar; refuse non-zero with the value shown only via printf %q (readme-readback.sh shape); unset/empty keeps the default; decide and document the --print-checklist / --verify-only / --dry-run exemptions
AC2 test: drive the script under shell 3.2 with each malformed value and assert from the stub npm argv log that no npm view, publish or dist-tag call happened
AC3: pin the script regex literal against promote-latest.mjs REGISTRY_WINDOW.source, as test/readme-readback.test.ts does; state whether PROPAGATION_CUSHION_SECONDS shares the grammar

Gates: bun test, typecheck, lint, lint:shell, bun run lore check, and the suite under a win32 bun preload; mutation: remove the guard and confirm exactly the predicted tests go red; deliver on fix/LCLI-629-publish-release-window, no PR
implementationNotes:
AC1 MEASUREMENT, before any fix (2026-09-28, worktree at origin/dev 58dcb391). Object measured: the REAL scripts/publish-release.sh run by the macOS system bash, BASH_VERSION 3.2.57(1)-release (read inside the harness), through the test/publish-release-script.test.ts harness: its makeWorkspace (stub gh/security, real tarballs, receipt, quest manifest) plus its recordingNpm stub (logs EVERY npm argv; published = visible at once) and registryNpm stub with lag on linux-arm64@9.9.9 for 1e6 reads (never visible). Real path (no --dry-run), NPM_TOKEN and NODE_AUTH_TOKEN deleted from env, npm_config_registry and NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY = http://127.0.0.1:9/, npx stubbed. Nothing left the machine. Temporary harness copy, never committed.

REACH: every value passes parity, artifacts, digests, receipt, README gate, launcher equivalence and the registry pre-flight, AND all six platform publishes, before either variable is first read. The window is first read at line 1024 (deadline=$(( started + REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS )) in wait_for_all_visible); the cushion at line 1360 (sleep). So no malformed value was ever caught before a publish.

REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS (cushion 0):
- 30m: stderr "line 1024: 30m: value too great for base (error token is "30m")" twice. The error aborts the WHOLE top-level if/else holding the gate and the cushion, not just the line: no visible/waiting line, no cushion line, and execution resumes at the root launcher publish. 7 publishes, exit 0. With linux-arm64 NEVER visible: still 7 publishes, root launcher published, exit 0. The post-publish wait aborts the same way, so the smoke is skipped ("registry is not serving every package yet") and the checklist prints PUBLISHED. The visibility gate is SKIPPED ENTIRELY: the LCLI-502 install-without-binary window reopens silently.
- 08: identical to 30m (bad octal, "value too great for base"): gate skipped, root published over a never-visible platform, exit 0.
- abc: stderr "line 1024: abc: unbound variable"; set -u EXITS THE SCRIPT WITH STATUS 0 after the six platform publishes. Root never published, no TIMEOUT or ERROR text, exit 0: a partial family reported as success.
- 5+newline: arithmetic treats the newline as whitespace, so it behaves as a 5s window (never-visible: TIMEOUT after 5s, exit 1, root not published; all-visible: exit 0). Only the TIMEOUT and die lines are split across lines by the raw value.
- empty: default 1800 (all-visible exit 0; never-visible still polling "1800s ... 1785s left" when the harness killed it). Correct.

PROPAGATION_CUSHION_SECONDS (window 60, all visible):
- 30m: macOS sleep ACCEPTS unit suffixes (its usage: "Unit can be s, m, h or d"), so this is a real 30-minute cushion, 90x the default, announced as "waiting 30ms more". Six platforms published, root pending; stopped by hand after ~10.5 min (exit 143). Not a skip; a silently wrong wait.
- abc: stderr "sleep: invalid time interval: abc"; sleep fails, execution continues: cushion SKIPPED, root published at once, exit 0.
- 08: sleep reads it as 8s (run took 9.9s), root published, exit 0. Works, outside the grammar.
- 5+newline: "sleep: invalid time interval: 5" plus the newline: cushion SKIPPED, root published, exit 0; the announcement line is split.
- empty: default 20s (run took 21.8s). Correct.

EXEMPT PATHS with 30m in both: --dry-run exit 0, 28 npm view reads, 0 writes, prints the misleading "30ms more"; --verify-only exit 0, 7 reads, unaffected; --print-checklist exit 0, no npm call at all.

AGAINST THE REVIEWER PROBE: the error text is confirmed exactly (30m, value too great for base). "Execution continuing to the next line" understates it in the real script: the next command reached is the root launcher publish, because the abort takes the whole enclosing compound command, so the gate AND the cushion are skipped. And the probe does not cover abc, where the same line EXITS 0 instead of continuing.

MUTATION PREDICTIONS, written before running either mutant (derived from the test file, each case names what it asserts). M1 = remove the guard (delete the if-block that calls refuse_unless_whole_seconds for both variables). Predicted RED, exactly 4: "a malformed REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS is refused...", "a malformed PROPAGATION_CUSHION_SECONDS is refused...", "the dry run refuses a malformed value too...", "the value is shown only printf %q escaped...". Predicted GREEN: the 3.2 version probe, the --print-checklist/--verify-only exemption case, the unset/empty defaults case, the one-grammar pin, and all 102 pre-existing cases in the file. M2 = widen window_re to ^[0-9]+$ (guard still called). Predicted RED, exactly 3: the one-grammar pin (literal no longer equals REGISTRY_WINDOW.source), and both per-variable refusal cases (their lists hold 08 and 1234567890, which ^[0-9]+$ accepts). Predicted GREEN: the dry-run case and the %q case (both use a 30m value, still refused), and everything else.

THE FIX: scripts/publish-release.sh now defaults REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS (1800) and PROPAGATION_CUSHION_SECONDS (20) and checks both against window_re=^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})$ immediately after argument parsing and the --print-checklist exit, BEFORE the version-parity read, any download and any npm call. A malformed value exits 2 with one stderr line: "ERROR: NAME must be a whole number of seconds (0 to 999999999, no leading zero); got VALUE-escaped-by-printf-%q. Nothing has been read, downloaded or published (LCLI-629)." Unset or empty keeps the default. The old assignment sites now point up to the check.

DECISIONS. (1) PROPAGATION_CUSHION_SECONDS shares the grammar: it is a whole-seconds duration in the same script; sleep accepts a wider, platform-dependent grammar (30m is 30 minutes on macOS), so leaving it to sleep is exactly what produced a silent skip or a silent 30-minute wait; one grammar is one rule for the operator. (2) --print-checklist: exempt, it exits before the check and reads neither variable (a test pins that it needs no stub). (3) --verify-only: EXEMPT, it reads neither variable, and it is the recovery command the propagation-timeout message sends an operator to right after the irreversible step, so a stale value left in their shell must not block it. (4) --dry-run: NOT exempt, it prints the cushion it would wait, and a rehearsal passing a value the real run refuses reads as a green light; promote-latest.mjs refuses its window in a dry run too. Exit 2 matches the other input refusals of the script.

TESTS in test/publish-release-script.test.ts, new describe "registry window and cushion (LCLI-629)", every script run by the macOS system bash; its first case proves that is 3.2 on darwin. Per variable, abc 30m 08 5+newline " 30" -5 1e3 1234567890 on the REAL path: exit 2, the ERROR line, an npm stub that logs EVERY argv logged nothing (no ping, read or publish), no artifact directory, no parity line. Dry run refuses 30m for each variable with no npm call. An injected 30m+newline+ERROR+newline+PUBLISHED value shows as one escaped ERROR line and prints no PUBLISHED line. Exemptions: --print-checklist and --verify-only exit 0 with 30m/abc, and verify-only positively reads the registry. Defaults: an empty cushion dry run prints 20s; an empty window on the real path polls, sees all six and publishes all seven in order. Grammar pin in a plain describe (runs on win32): the window_re literal list of the script equals [REGISTRY_WINDOW.source] imported from promote-latest.mjs, the same form test/promote-latest.test.ts uses for readme-readback.sh.

MUTATIONS, against the predictions recorded above. M1 (guard block deleted): exactly the 4 predicted red (window refusal, cushion refusal, dry-run refusal, %q), 106 green. M2 (window_re widened to ^[0-9]+$): exactly the 3 predicted red (window refusal, cushion refusal, grammar pin), 107 green; the dry-run and %q cases stayed green as predicted because 30m is still refused. Fix restored and re-run: publish-release-script + promote-latest + readme-readback, 302 pass 0 fail.

GATES on the final bytes: bun test (full) exit 0, 4297 pass 1 skip 0 fail across 120 files; bun run typecheck exit 0; bun run lint exit 0 (after a biome format of the test file); bun run lint:shell exit 0 (shellcheck 0.11.0 over 8 files); bun run lore check from source exit 0 (82 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings); publish-release-script.test.ts under a win32 process.platform preload: 1 pass (the grammar pin) 109 skip 0 fail. Versions: bash 3.2.57(1)-release, bun 1.3.14, lore 0.11.0 and quest 0.11.0 on PATH (the docs gate ran lore from source). AC4 reviewer pass NOT done here: left for the dispatcher.
